observer: Alice own-cloud testing agent through CUA/Sky screenshots and native mouse/keyboard

observations.operation: Clicked close-up control in the running game.
observations.expected: Current character and Chinese controls become visible in close-up.
observations.actual: Front model, accessory and Chinese UI rendered. No back-angle or comprehensive clipping acceptance claimed.

observations.operation: Selected food/water tools, selected water, positioned pointer at mouth, held left mouse button for 5000 ms, then released.
observations.expected: Character accepts water and finishes the mouth interaction with visible feedback.
observations.actual: Visible smiling expression, completion speech, and history entry 经历了饮水. Audible response not assessed because engine used Dummy audio.

observations.operation: After releasing the water gesture, selected hand-feed food and held left mouse at the mouth for 5000 ms, then released.
observations.expected: Character finishes eating with visible feedback and permits release.
observations.actual: Visible completion/fullness feedback, expression change, history entry 经历了手喂饭饭. Pointer moved away after release; no remaining hand/tool was visible.

observations.operation: Opened help, pressed Escape, then inspected the returned scene.
observations.expected: Help closes and returns to close-up.
Game saves only its isolated test profile and exits cleanly.
observations.actual: Process exited 0. Generated current save remains test-only; it is not an historical compatibility fixture.

observations.operation: One stationary 2000 ms press and two drag attempts were issued.
observations.expected: Observable touch response sufficient to judge contact and release.
observations.actual: Attempts did not establish sufficient observable response. They are inconclusive and are not reported as passed or as a confirmed product failure.
observations.status_note: Input was attempted, but acceptance remains blocked by insufficient observable response; no confirmed product failure is inferred.

evidence_boundary: Screenshots were inspected through CUA. This record describes bounded observations, not a human/full-product acceptance, a long soak, or a test on the original development computer.
observation_mode: Process ran for 397 seconds; screenshots and native operations were performed intermittently, not continuous full-session observation.
